title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Cabin Fever
Unlike prison inmates who have already been convicted and sentenced for their crimes, most jail inmates stand charged and are still working their cases through the court system; the process can take years, so some try to make their jail cells home.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wake Up Call
Confinement takes a dark turn for a light-hearted teenager, but provides a new beginning for an old bank robber inside the Orange County Jail; a mother who has put drugs before her son gets another chance.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — "Old School" Convicts
A brutal stabbing puts Indiana State Prison on edge; a brash new inmate gets taken down a notch; two buddies do their time together; cameras are put into the hands of inmates who share intimate thoughts about life behind bars.

title: Lockup
description:
S2 E10 — Inside Angola
Angola Penitentiary in Louisiana.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bitter Pills
An inmate with a long record runs an extortion scheme, while drugs inside the jail pose a lethal threat; the jail's newest team member makes her presence known.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — You Feel Me?
A drug-addicted mother asks a judge to keep her out of prison; just brought in on drug charges, a young man attempts to make bail, while another awaits sentencing for an unthinkable crime.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — The Wrong Fight
A new arrival in the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution raises serious concerns throughout the maximum-security prison; young correctional officer cadets experience the burn as each one takes a pepper spray shot in the eye.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E3 — Gone in the Gulf; The Anti-Social Network
A man accused of stealing $40 million from investors gets on a boat in Key West and is never seen again; a trio of geeks puts computer users into compromising positions with porn.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E6 — Diamonds Aren't Forever; Cover Your Assets
A real estate developer with a sterling reputation ends up in bankruptcy court; a CEO is charged with overseeing accounting fraud to inflate his company's worth to investors while pocketing a fortune.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Close Quarters
The vast majority of inmates live in two-man cells but even with careful screening, conflicts can still arise between cellmates; one inmate covers up his own beating, and plucked from death row, another inmate tries to make a difference.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Lines
An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Sufferin' County
A female inmate finds romance with an alleged gang leader and the jailhouse prepares for a wedding; a very powerful inmate must make a choice between his crime family and his real family.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — No More Franks And Beans
A first time inmate says he must turn to violence to avoid becoming a victim, an accused rapist gets into more trouble in jail and what he does next has some questioning his motives.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Permanent Scars
An inmate says a bet for two cups of soup led to a horrific slashing; a case of road rage results in a murder charge for a software engineer; after two years in jail, a jury will decide if he must go to prison for life.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Crackdown
When Travis Trani took charge in 2008 he oversaw the implementation of several new policies; the restrictions on movement were among the toughest; inmates from the six different housing units could no longer freely move throughout the prison.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Hurts
Even for inmates serving hard time, love can be a strong motivator; in prison, reaching out to others can be a dicey proposition; some inmates just don't know when someone's getting too close until it's too late.
